verdicts.Q1_parity_p4_uninformative: parity_contrast(p=4)=0.728 on the lattice. Per Theorem 1 this statistic is +1 for ANY even/odd signal, so its firing here carries no period-4 information.
verdicts.Q2_Mp_resolution: mean M profile = (M2=0.710, M4=0.758, M6=0.715); 41% of nodes argmax at p=4. A period-2 signal yields a FLAT profile (control: {"2": 1.0, "4": 1.0, "6": 1.0}), so a peak at 4 is genuine residue structure.
verdicts.Q3_C4_reproduces: C4=R0-R2 on lattice = 0.180 vs treaty's 0.257; control period-2 gives 0.000, so C4 IS a genuine mod-4 discriminator (uses 2-bit residue info, unlike parity_contrast).
